{{Quote|The training manual will be your guide, my young apprentice. Each section will teach you an important part of the Jedi way.|The Jedi narrator|<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: Junior Jedi Training Manual">''[[Star Wars Episode I: Junior Jedi Training Manual]]''</ref>}}
The '''Junior Jedi Training Manual''' was an instructional book written by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] around the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. It was aimed at the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]], who were nicknamed "Junior Jedi" in that book. The manual detailed the basic tenets of the Jedi way and also included a variety of information pertaining to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in general, such as an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] identification chart. A spoken narration recorded by a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and included with the manual. Although the book could be used without the recording, some secrets were only revealed in the tape. Somehow, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] known as [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] managed to tamper with the record, adding some of his thoughts on the Jedi Order.
